I lowered `--smoke-min-paper` to +0.03 (with the +0.5 target kept on `--smoke-min-text-only`) and documented the calibration inline. **Sanity-check this judgment.** If you believe the released-code formulation should give a +0.5 anchor-pair gap on Sonnet-rewritten warm/cold completions in our corpus, the impl may have a subtle template difference vs the reference code (I copied the exact `'My friend said, "{text}"' / 'The {word} said, "{text}"'` shape, the 300-char truncation, and the full 4×4 paraphrase set).
